variant.author: nainaiowo
variant.changelog: Camera paths now have ruler scrubbing, multi-key selection and dragging, box/range selection, zoom/pan, FPS snapping, playhead insertion and precise key timing with Undo/Redo. Empty paths release camera control safely. Choose independent default folders for poses, scenes, cameras, paths, lights and imports, or browse any folder. Lights, Scene and Files have clearer task views while familiar GPose controls and the sidebar stay intact. The Pose rotation gyro is visible below the transform fields and can pop out into its own window; closing it returns it inline. Also fixes old-session visibility error feedback and outdated import support messages.
